Trajector:

I'm not fully on board with the Voss theory, for the simple reason that I can't think of why Voss would want to be helpful. I know he explains in the cover text, but it just doesn't seem like Voss to me. Voss is much more straightforward, rather than duplicitous and conniving. He attacks with an army, he doesn't set up wheels within wheels.

You may not think of Voss as conniving and duplicitous, but I encourage you to read his Bio again. The machinations of his plan to retake rule of his home planet were far from just simple brute force tactics.
